svg.aria-label: Down the stack, from high level to the machine. HTML and CSS: learning. Python: solid. Java: learning. C: curious. Assembly: curious. A red pulse runs from Python down to Assembly. Next: security, across every layer, and AI systems that keep working when an API fails.
